rows.note_en: The pilot does not score local variable letters; retain as reviewer context.
Pinned `linter.unicodeLinter` character/variant legality plus separate human readability review; the allow-list is snapshot-specific.
Alphabetical labels apply only inside ordinary `public import` and `import` blocks. `Mathlib.Tactic` remains a hard negative; justified benchmarked `Lake.*` imports are warning/review cases.
`Main definitions`/`Main statements` are optional; `Notation`, `References`, and `Tags` are conditional on file content.
Omitted binder types are violations only when they obscure a public signature; inferable dependent indices/universes are accepted exceptions.
Empty-line deterministic labels are restricted to the pinned linter's syntax/path scope; excluded contexts require assisted review.

rows.source_section: Naming guide: theorem and structural names

rows.note_en: Field documentation defaults to every new explicit field with limited exceptions. Docstring mechanics, prose style, and exact-name resolution receive separate labels.

rows.source_section: Documentation guide: proof sketches and literature

rows.note_en: Tool output from `#min_imports in` and incremental `linter.minImports` is separated from dependency-architecture judgment in LOCATE/DETECT.
Ordinary transformation parity is `SHOULD`; explicit `existing`, existing-companion, unsupported-constant, naming-override, and generated-API-hazard cases are contextual exceptions.
Only the exact `setOption` option families are deterministic failures; other scoped technical options require necessity review.
Native-decision trust validation combines syntax-linter coverage with the pinned `leanchecker` gate; syntax-only success is insufficient.
A separate performance benchmark is required.
Only code-local deprecated tactic syntax is included; repository-wide migrations are out of scope.
Recorded as release/use policy, not a code-style label.
